endpoints.description: Lists the closure PDFs attached to this traveler's inputs, as a flat array the client filters by input_name — the same convention as GET /travelers/:id/ncr-links/ and GET /travelers/:id/notes/. Deliberately a separate endpoint from ncr-links: a PDF must still be listed after its NCR has been deleted, and ncr-links is derived from live NCR documents.
endpoints.authorization: Same as viewing the traveler: auth.ensureAuthenticated, reqUtils.exist('id', Traveler), reqUtils.canReadMw('id'). No NCR-specific access check (spec FR-024).
notes: Query: TravelerNcrPdf.find({ traveler: id }).sort({ generatedOn: 1 }).lean(). An input with no closed linked NCR simply has no entries.
Several entries may share an input_name — each closed NCR has its own PDF (spec FR-025).

endpoints.description: Serves one closure PDF for viewing or download.
endpoints.authorization: Same as above — read access to the traveler.

success_200.body: the PDF bytes (res.sendFile of the server-side path, resolved with path.resolve — the same idiom routes/traveler.js already uses for record files)

errors.not_found_404: pdfId is not a valid ObjectId, no such record, or the record belongs to a DIFFERENT traveler. The lookup is { _id: pdfId, traveler: :id } so an id cannot be fetched through another traveler's URL.
errors.gone_410: the record exists but its file is missing on disk (logged server-side; the response does not reveal the path)

sections_in_order: Header: NCR number, status, creation and closure dates
Traveler and input: traveler title and id, input label and name
Part, supplier and PO information, WBS number, specification/drawing reference
Nonconformance: description, discovery date and context
Originator (and Designate if any) and the assigned CE/CS
Disposition: parts disposition, rework/repair instructions, CE/CS identity and timestamp
Review and approval outcomes: QA concurrence, each approver's status, timestamp and comments
Preventive actions: description, owner, target and actual dates, status, comments
Closure record: closed by, closure date, disposition-execution and preventive-action verification, traveler sign-off
Attachments: file names only — contents are not embedded
Event history: every event in order with timestamp, actor and status change
properties: A snapshot as of closure; never regenerated or edited afterwards (FR-028)
Text only, drawn with an embedded Unicode font; no HTML/CSS/URL is rendered from NCR content
Characters outside the font (e.g. CJK) render as the font's missing-glyph box and never fail generation
